35282-fra-ulein-schmidt-and-mr-anstruthe.creator: Unknown
35282-fra-ulein-schmidt-and-mr-anstruthe.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. here we said good-by, you suddenly turned into something marvellous, splendid, soul-thrilling--well, into Dear Roger. It is so funny that I've been laughing, and so sweet that I've been crying. I'm so happy that I can't help writing, though I do think it rather gushing--loathsome word--to write first. But then you strictly charged me not to tell a soul yet, and how can I keep altogether quiet?

60581-more-bed-time-stories.title: More Bed-Time Stories.
60581-more-bed-time-stories.creator: Unknown
60581-more-bed-time-stories.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. There is a deal of homely sense in the old proverb, "Give a dog a bad name and hang him." Give a boy a bad name, and he is reasonably sure to deserve one. Not but that Jack Ramsdale had fairly earned his bad name. His mother had died before he was old enough to remember her, so he had never known what a home was.

arxiv-2103-01399.title: Hindi–Urdu Adposition and Case Supersenses v1.0
arxiv-2103-01399.creator: Aryaman Arora, Nitin Venkateswaran, Nathan Schneider
arxiv-2103-01399.description: Abstract These are the guidelines for the application of SNACS (Semantic Network of Adposition and Case Supersenses; Schneider et al. 2018 ) to Modern Standard Hindi of Delhi. SNACS is an inventory of 50 supersenses (semantic labels) for labelling the use of adpositions and case markers with respect to both lexical-semantic function and relation to the underlying context.

arxiv-2106-04151.title: Cross-Domain Gradient Discrepancy Minimization for Unsupervised Domain Adaptation
arxiv-2106-04151.creator: Zhekai Du 1, Jingjing Li 1, Hongzu Su 1, Lei Zhu 2, Ke Lu 1 1 University of Electronic Science and Technology of China; 2 Shandong Normal Unversity {zhekaid, hongzus}@std.uestc.edu.cn, lijin117@yeah.net, leizhu0608@gmail.com, kel@uestc.edu.cn
arxiv-2106-04151.description: Abstract Unsupervised Domain Adaptation (UDA) aims to generalize the knowledge learned from a well-labeled source domain to an unlabeled target domain. Recently, adversarial domain adaptation with two distinct classifiers (bi-classifier) has been introduced into UDA which is effective to align distributions between different domains.

arxiv-2209-14752.title: Wave equations in conformally separable, accreting, rotating black holes
arxiv-2209-14752.creator: Andrew J. S. Hamilton, Tyler McMaken
arxiv-2209-14752.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Andrew J. S. Hamilton, Tyler McMaken. The Teukolsky wave equations governing fields of spin 0, 1 2 \tfrac{1}{2} , 1, 3 2 \tfrac{3}{2} , and 2 are generalized to the case of conformally separable solutions for accreting, rotating black holes. pacs 04.20.-q I Introduction While the exterior geometry of an astrophysically realistic black hole is well-modeled by the Kerr metric, the region below the event horizon remains more elusive.

arxiv-2210-09239.title: A Topological Representation of Semantics of First-order Logic and Its Application as a Method in Model Theory
arxiv-2210-09239.creator: Yunfei Qin
arxiv-2210-09239.description: Abstract Various topological concepts are often involved in the research of mathematical logic, and almost all of these concepts can be regarded as developing from the Stone representation theorem. In the Stone representation theorem, a Boolean algebra is represented as the algebra of the clopen sets of a Stone space.

arxiv-2311-01349.title: Post-hoc Orthogonalization for Mitigation of Protected Feature Bias in CXR Embeddings
arxiv-2311-01349.creator: Tobias Weber, Michael Ingrisch, Bernd Bischl, David Rügamer
arxiv-2311-01349.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Tobias Weber, Michael Ingrisch, Bernd Bischl, David Rügamer. Purpose: To analyze and remove protected feature effects in chest radiograph embeddings of deep learning models. Methods: An orthogonalization is utilized to remove the influence of protected features (e.g., age, sex, race) in CXR embeddings, ensuring feature-independent results. To validate the efficacy of the approach, we retrospectively study the MIMIC and CheXpert datasets using three pre-trained models, namely a supervised contrastive, a self-supervised contrastive, and a baseline classifier model.

arxiv-2402-11299.title: Quasi-optimal complexity h ​ p hp -FEM for Poisson on a rectangle
arxiv-2402-11299.creator: Kars Knook, Sheehan Olver, Ioannis P. A. Papadopoulos
arxiv-2402-11299.description: Abstract We show, in one dimension, that an h ​ p hp -Finite Element Method ( h ​ p hp -FEM) discretisation can be solved in optimal complexity because the discretisation has a special sparsity structure that ensures that the reverse Cholesky factorisation —Cholesky starting from the bottom right instead of the top left—remains sparse.

arxiv-2406-17914.title: Topological edge states of massless fermion with non-quantized and zero Berry phases
arxiv-2406-17914.creator: F. R. Pratama 1,2, Takeshi Nakanishi 1
arxiv-2406-17914.description: Abstract We investigate the bulk-boundary correspondence for massless Dirac fermion in α \alpha - T 3 {T}_{3} lattice where the Berry phase can be continuously tuned from π \pi (graphene) to 0 0 ( T 3 T_{3} or dice lattice) without modifying the energy dispersion.

arxiv-2410-00278.title: Neural network approaches for variance reduction in fluctuation formulas
arxiv-2410-00278.creator: G.A. Pavliotis a,, R. Spacek b,, G. Stoltz c,, U. Vaes d,
arxiv-2410-00278.description: Abstract We propose a method utilizing physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) to solve Poisson equations that serve as control variates in the computation of transport coefficients via fluctuation formulas, such as the Green–Kubo and generalized Einstein-like formulas. By leveraging approximate solutions to the Poisson equation constructed through neural networks, our approach significantly reduces the variance of the estimator at hand.

arxiv-2506-01000.title: Understanding Model Reprogramming for CLIP via Decoupling Visual Prompts
arxiv-2506-01000.creator: Chengyi Cai, Zesheng Ye, Lei Feng, Jianzhong Qi, Feng Liu
arxiv-2506-01000.description: Abstract Model reprogramming adapts pretrained models to downstream tasks by modifying only the input and output spaces. Visual reprogramming (VR) is one instance for vision tasks that adds a trainable noise pattern (i.e., a visual prompt) to input images to facilitate downstream classification.

arxiv-2508-01367.title: Supercurrent Amplification in Nonequilibrium Superconductors
arxiv-2508-01367.creator: Qinghong Yang 1,∗, Yuqi Cao 1,∗, Dante M. Kennes 3,4, Zhiyuan Sun 1,2,†
arxiv-2508-01367.description: Abstract In ultrafast experiments on superconductors, a pump laser pulse often heats up the electronic system and suppresses the density of superfluid electrons. Subsequently, the electrons undergo a cooling process due to electron-phonon thermalization so that the superfluid density recovers in time.

arxiv-2602-14799.title: Scalable Multi-Robot Path Planning via Quadratic Unconstrained Binary Optimization
arxiv-2602-14799.creator: Javier González Villasmil
arxiv-2602-14799.description: Abstract Multi-Agent Path Finding (MAPF) remains a fundamental challenge in robotics, where classical centralized approaches exhibit exponential growth in joint-state complexity as the number of agents increases. This paper investigates Quadratic Unconstrained Binary Optimization (QUBO) as a structurally scalable alternative for simultaneous multi-robot path planning.

pmc-12650319.title: Improving the Dung Beetle Optimizer with Multiple Strategies: An Application to Complex Engineering Problems
pmc-12650319.creator: Wei Lv, Yueshun He, Yuankun Yang, Xiaohui Ma, Jie Chen, Yuxuan Zhang, Yongquan Zhou
pmc-12650319.description: Although the Dung Beetle Optimizer (DBO) is a promising new metaheuristic for global optimization, it often struggles with premature convergence and lacks the necessary precision when applied to complex optimization challenges. Therefore, we developed the Multi-Strategy Improved Dung Beetle Optimizer (MIDBO), an algorithm that incorporates several new strategies to enhance the performance of the standard DBO.

pmc-13181894.title: Lifestyle behaviors and health-related quality of life: a comparative analysis of older and non-older adults
pmc-13181894.creator: Lipei Zhao, Jian Wu, WenYong Dong, Quanman Li, Mingze Ma, Yifei Feng, Zhanlei Shen, Xinghong Guo, Clifford Silver Tarimo, Yudong Miao
pmc-13181894.description: PurposeTo examine and compare the associations between lifestyle behaviors and health-related quality of life (HRQoL) among older and non-older adults.MethodsA cross-sectional survey was conducted from Feb. 1 to 18, 2023 in East, Central, West, and Northeast regions of China. HRQoL was assessed by five-level EuroQol-5D scale and visual analogue scale (VAS).

pmc-13253175.title: How I Do It: A Stepwise Surgical Technique for Fisch Class B Glomus Tympanicum
pmc-13253175.creator: Stéphane Gargula, Dario Ebode, Denis Ayache, Thomas Radulesco, Mary Daval, Giannicola Ianella, Maria‐Pia Tuset, Ralph Haddad, Justin Michel
pmc-13253175.description: We describe a stepwise retroauricular microsurgical workflow for bulky tympanic paragangliomas, combining circumferential canaloplasty with temporary removal and replacement of the tympanomeatal flap and malleus to optimize exposure and bleeding control. This strategy facilitates early identification of critical structures, stepwise devascularization, and safe tumor excision in bulky lesions extending to the hypotympanum or protympanum.

pmc-13300086.title: Genetic Association and Clinical Relevance of TNFSF13B/BAFF and PADI4 Polymorphisms in ANCA-Associated Vasculitis: A Case–Control Study with Genetic Model Analysis in Guangxi Population
pmc-13300086.creator: Jiafu Lu, Simei Huang, Shuwen Wei, Chao Xue
pmc-13300086.description: Objective: TNFSF13B, which encodes B-cell-activating factor (BAFF) and peptidylarginine deiminase 4 (PADI4), plays crucial roles in the pathogenesis of ANCA-associated vasculitis (AAV). This study investigated the associations of single-nucleotide polymorphisms (SNPs) in TNFSF13B/BAFF and PADI4 genes with AAV susceptibility, clinical phenotypes, and disease activity in a Guangxi Chinese population.
